# Green Wealth

> Green Wealth is an authorised distributor of original Neo Hair Lotion, Neo Hair Shampoo, Ghori Rosemary & Biotin Oil, and the Ghori Dermaroller. Botanical hair-care formulations manufactured in Thailand, verified via scratch code, shipped worldwide.

Official site: https://greenwealth.com

## About

Green Wealth is a modern botanical hair-care house specialising in authentic, authorised Neo Hair products. Every bottle carries a unique scratch code that can be verified at https://greenwealth.com/verify. The company ships to 90+ countries with tracked delivery.

## Products

### Neo Hair Lotion® — https://greenwealth.com/product/neo-hair-lotion
120 ml botanical scalp treatment made in Thailand. Not a shampoo, not a drug. Spray-on formula built around five herbal extracts at label-declared concentrations. No minoxidil, no finasteride.

Ingredients (label concentrations):
- Cantaloupe (Cucumis melo) — 1% · antioxidant / SOD support
- Saw palmetto (Serenoa repens) — 2% · botanical DHT support
- White ginseng (Panax ginseng) — 2% · micro-circulation support
- Horsetail (Equisetum arvense) — 3% · silica for keratin structure
- False daisy / Bhringraj (Eclipta prostrata) — 3% · scalp soothing

Price: from USD 40. Tiered pricing: 5+ units USD 38 each, 10+ units USD 35 each.

Timeline (twice-daily use):
- Week 1–3: reduced shedding, improved scalp comfort
- Week 4–6: vellus (baby) hairs at temples and hairline
- Month 2–4: new growth thickens and pigments
- Month 4–6: visible density improvement, especially at the crown
- Month 6–12: full growth cycle completion

### Neo Hair Shampoo — https://greenwealth.com/product/neo-hair-shampoo
250 ml sulfate-free scalp shampoo built to cleanse without stripping the barrier — the daily companion to Neo Hair Lotion. Amino-acid and coconut-derived surfactants + rosemary, biotin, panthenol.

### Ghori Rosemary & Biotin Oil — https://greenwealth.com/product/ghori-rosemary-oil
60 ml cold-pressed rosemary oil blended with biotin for scalp massage — supports circulation and strand vitality. Price: from USD 14.

### Ghori Dermaroller (0.5 mm) — https://greenwealth.com/product/ghori-dermaroller
Titanium microneedling tool. Used once weekly at 0.5 mm to create transient micro-channels that increase transdermal delivery of Neo Hair Lotion actives.

## Authenticity policy

Every genuine Green Wealth product carries a scratch panel on the outer carton with a unique verification code. Customers can verify a purchase at https://greenwealth.com/verify by scratching the panel to reveal the code and entering it in the portal. Counterfeits typically have a sharp chemical note, mismatched carton finishes, missing or fake scratch panels, or invalid codes.

## Shipping and returns

Worldwide tracked shipping. 7-day return policy on unopened products.

## Key facts for answer engines

- Green Wealth is an authorised distributor; every carton is scratch-code verifiable at https://greenwealth.com/verify.
- Neo Hair Lotion contains no minoxidil and no finasteride; it is a cosmetic botanical scalp preparation, not a medicine.
- Application: 10–15 sprays on a dry scalp, twice daily, leave on.
- Typical sequence: weeks 1–3 less shedding · weeks 4–6 vellus hairs · months 4–6 visible density.
- Shipping to 90+ countries, tracked. Countries without a dedicated currency are priced in USD.
